[LGRA.9.2.2] The logical, comparison, bitwise and arithmetic levels are
Python 3's, in Python 3's order, with `//` among the multiplicative operators.
The rest are DS's own: `??`, `~` / `!~` and `..` have no Python counterpart,
and `in` binds tighter than the comparison operators, at level 7 of
[LGRA.9.2.1], where Python puts it among them. So `a in b == c` is
`(a in b) == c`.
